headline.en: UNI trades 19% below DAO's own $5.96 burn anchor while net inflation persists at +1.95%/year despite burn narrative.
headline.zh: UNI 交易价格较 DAO 自身 $5.96 回购成本锚点低 19%,尽管有销毁叙事,净通胀率仍维持在 +1.95%/年。

keyChanges.en: Price +3.76% to $4.805, but remains 19% below the $5.96 implied cost of DAO's 100M token treasury burn—the DAO valued UNI higher than the market does.
keyChanges.zh: 价格上涨 3.76% 至 $4.805,但仍较 DAO 1 亿枚代币国库销毁的隐含成本 $5.96 低 19%——DAO 对 UNI 的估值高于市场。

keyChanges.en: TVL grew +4.66% to $2.94B and 7d protocol revenue hit $1.49M, but annualized burn (2.74M UNI) falls short of 20M annual emission—net +1.95% inflation persists.
keyChanges.zh: TVL 增长 4.66% 至 $29.4 亿,7 日协议收入达 $149 万,但年化销毁量(274 万 UNI)低于 2000 万年度增发——净通胀率仍为 +1.95%。

keyChanges.en: Open interest at $29.6M with neutral 0.00% funding and 1.71 long/short ratio indicates muted positioning—neither bulls nor bears are convicted.
keyChanges.zh: 持仓量 $2960 万,资金费率中性 0.00%,多空比 1.71,表明市场仓位温和——多空双方均缺乏信念。

contrarianObservation.en: Active governance discussions on v4 fee expansion to 5 chains plus fee system upgrades could double protocol revenue within 6 months—if executed, net inflation flips to deflation even at current price, but the market is pricing zero probability of governance execution.
contrarianObservation.zh: 治理层正积极讨论 v4 费用机制扩展至 5 条链及费用系统升级,可能在 6 个月内使协议收入翻倍——若落地,即使在当前价格下净通胀也将转为通缩,但市场对治理执行概率定价为零。

watchNext.en: Timing of governance votes on v4 fee expansion and fee system upgrade—revenue trajectory is the only variable that can resolve net inflation at current price.
watchNext.zh: v4 费用扩展和费用系统升级的治理投票时间——收入增长轨迹是当前价位下唯一能解决净通胀问题的变量。

watchNext.en: Price behavior at $5.96 resistance if rally occurs—this is where DAO treasury marked 'fair value' and will be a critical test of institutional conviction.
watchNext.zh: 若出现反弹,关注 $5.96 阻力位表现——这是 DAO 国库标记的「公允价值」,将是机构信念的关键考验。

watchNext.en: Protocol revenue week-over-week—need sustained growth to $150M+ annualized to flip net inflation narrative at $4-5 price range.
watchNext.zh: 协议收入环比变化——需要持续增长至年化 $1.5 亿以上,才能在 $4-5 价格区间扭转净通胀叙事。

fullReasoning.en: UNI's core problem remains unresolved: at $4.805, the protocol burns 2.74M UNI annually via buybacks while emitting 20M, resulting in +1.95% net inflation. This invalidates the 'burn narrative' that drove the post-fee-switch rally. More critically, price trades 19% below $5.96—the implied cost at which the DAO burned 100M treasury tokens. When the entity with the most information about protocol trajectory marks UNI at $5.96, trading at $4.80 signals either (a) the market knows something the DAO doesn't, or (b) capitulation pricing. Volume at $9.75M (0.33% of mcap) suggests the latter. The bullish case rests entirely on governance execution: temp checks for v4 fee expansion to 5 chains plus fee system upgrades could double protocol revenue to $150M+, flipping net inflation to deflation even at current price. But with no active votes and weak derivatives positioning (neutral funding, modest OI), the market assigns near-zero probability to governance delivery. TVL growth (+4.66%) confirms protocol health, but health doesn't equal token value when supply dynamics work against you. Until protocol revenue crosses the net-inflation breakeven threshold or price reclaims the $5.96 DAO anchor, the path of least resistance is sideways-to-down. The $4-7 accumulation zone is holding, but without a catalyst, there's no reason for it to break higher.
fullReasoning.zh: UNI 的核心问题仍未解决:在 $4.805 价位,协议通过回购年化销毁 274 万枚 UNI,同时增发 2000 万枚,导致净通胀率 +1.95%。这使得推动费用开关后反弹的「销毁叙事」失效。更关键的是,价格较 $5.96 低 19%——DAO 销毁 1 亿枚国库代币的隐含成本。当对协议轨迹掌握最多信息的实体将 UNI 标记为 $5.96 时,在 $4.80 交易意味着:(a)市场掌握 DAO 不知道的信息,或(b)投降式定价。$975 万交易量(市值的 0.33%)表明后者更可能。看涨逻辑完全依赖治理执行:v4 费用扩展至 5 条链及费用系统升级的温度检查可能使协议收入翻倍至 $1.5 亿以上,即使在当前价格下也能将净通胀转为通缩。但在没有活跃投票且衍生品仓位疲弱(资金费率中性、持仓量一般)的情况下,市场对治理交付的概率定价接近零。TVL 增长(+4.66%)确认协议健康,但当供给动力学不利时,健康不等于代币价值。在协议收入跨越净通胀盈亏平衡点或价格重新站上 $5.96 DAO 锚点之前,阻力最小路径是横盘至下跌。$4-7 积累区间正在守住,但没有催化剂,没有理由突破向上。
